# [TASK] Authenticate ai-service's entry points and stop trusting interpolated text as structure

## Task

Authenticate every entry point into ai-service and stop trusting caller-controlled text as structure.

- REST: user-scoped endpoints (`/chat`, `/recommendations`, `/search/semantic`) take the caller's identity from the gateway-issued `X-User-Id` header (`dev.lmdb.ai.security.CallerIdentity`) instead of a request-body field, with a 401 mapping for a missing header.
- api-gateway: `JwtAuthenticationFilter` strips any client-supplied `X-User-*` header on every inbound request, on every path (public and protected), before doing anything else.
- gRPC: every RPC on ai-service's gRPC surface is authenticated by a `ServerInterceptor` against a shared service token, fail-closed when unconfigured.
- Prompt construction: conversation history is passed to the model as typed messages instead of concatenated `"role: content"` text; caller- and catalog-sourced text interpolated into prompts is flattened and length-capped first.
- Supply chain: the Vosk speech-to-text model fetched at image build time is checksum-verified before being unpacked.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] A user-scoped REST endpoint with no valid caller-identity header is rejected with 401, and the caller's identity is never taken from the request body (`AiServiceIntegrationTest.chatWithoutIdentityHeaderIsUnauthorized`, `.recommendWithoutIdentityHeaderIsUnauthorized`, `.semanticSearchWithoutIdentityHeaderIsUnauthorized`, `.chatIgnoresUserIdSuppliedInTheBody`)
- [x] api-gateway strips a client-supplied `X-User-*` header on every path, authenticated or not, and forwards only the identity it extracted from the token (`JwtAuthenticationFilterTest.filter_shouldStripForgedIdentityHeadersWhenUnauthenticated`, `.filter_shouldStripForgedIdentityHeadersOnPublicPaths`, `.filter_shouldOverrideForgedIdentityWithTokenIdentity`)
- [x] ai-service's gRPC surface closes a call with no token or the wrong token, and fails closed when no token is configured (`GrpcAuthInterceptorTest.missingTokenIsRejected`, `.wrongTokenIsRejected`, `.unconfiguredInterceptorFailsClosed`)
- [x] Text interpolated into a model prompt cannot forge additional conversation turns or role instructions (`AiServiceIntegrationTest.chatMessageCannotForgeAdditionalTurns`, `.parseQuerySanitizesInputBeforeItReachesThePrompt`)
- [x] The Docker build step that unpacks the Vosk archive fails on a checksum mismatch (`backend/ai-service/Dockerfile`'s `sha256sum -c` step; the two checksums are still #229's placeholders, so the step fails on every build until that lands)

## Estimate

**Hours:** 6

## Notes

Implemented and pushed to `develop`. Checksum verification exists but does not yet check real hashes; #229 tracks pinning the real values.
